description: Every erasure, reification, projection, and substitution transition between two census representations. A transition names the source and destination representations, the kind of transformation, and the anchor that owns it; the census validator rejects a transition whose endpoints are not inventoried representations.

transitions.summary: Normalized parser union members lower into runtime union_alternatives in the same canonical order; the alternatives are deliberately not stored in container_element_types because they are parts of a set, not of one value.
A tagged union is an ENUM with no runtime ENUM kind: its values are positional read-only Arrays and its meta type a Dictionary; enum_case_payloads field names are an analyzer-only convenience.
Type parameters are erased before execution; a runtime TYPE_PARAMETER node accepts any value defensively. The only runtime form that keeps TYPE_PARAMETER nodes is a FIXED member binding.

A FIXED binding stores an FSDataType that keeps TYPE_PARAMETER nodes at any depth, so each further extends step substitutes them recursively and a leaf supplying the last parameter resolves the whole type.

The declared integer width lowers with the carrier it constrains; a width reconstructed from a carrier-only boundary keeps numeric_type_is_carrier_erased provenance and must not be copied into a constraint slot (as_container_slot_type, modules/foundry_script/fs_parser.h:372).

encode_data_type writes kind, carrier, width, native and trait names, flags, parameter identity, script reference, and all three recursive child vectors; decode_data_type rebuilds them and rejects a kind above UNION or an out-of-range or carrier-inconsistent width.
The loader rebuilds live FSDataType records from serialized bytes; a reloaded script enforces the same constraints as a text-compiled one, so every child that survived serialization is reified here.

A plain PropertyInfo round trip keeps only the carrier: a slot that stores just a carrier decodes to the wide spelling. Tuples erase to a bare untyped Array; unions degrade to the shared carrier or Variant.

type_from_property reconstructs a parser DataType from a PropertyInfo; a width it recovers from the carrier alone is provenance-marked numeric_type_is_carrier_erased so it describes a value range, never a constraint.

FSDataType::from_container_type and the ContainerType lowering are the bridge between script-typed slots and engine-level typed containers; element widths and reified arguments both survive the crossing.

get_source_type_name reconstructs the Foundry Script spelling from the stored descriptor alone, never from a runtime value; containers, generic arguments, tuples, and nullability recurse, so widths stay distinguishable.
An instance and a class handle both reduce to a leaf script plus reified arguments; an unspecialized handle reports no evidence, which is gradual acceptance rather than a claim.

A tuple member's declared shape is preserved as tuple_slot_shape beside the erased Array data_type, so a reflective write — which has only the slot type to go on — still rejects a wrong-arity or wrong-element Array.
